pages.text: [#](53341a)A desperate infernal recovery-working for calling back what was lost in death.[#]()
pages.title: Rite of Prior Incarnation

pages.text: [#](53341a)It does not reverse the death — it drags your fallen belongings back before the world scatters them.[#]()
[#](53341a)Worked on a small infernal circle with a **Necromantic Stone**, **Tongue of Dog**, **Bone**, **Spectral Dust**, and a **Charged Attuned Stone**.[#]()
pages.title: The Working

pages.text: [#](53341a)Cast it in the same world, within **16 blocks** of where you fell.[#]()
[#](53341a)Loose drops are pulled toward you, your inventory first.[#]()
[#](53341a)No answer to Keep Inventory or another world — but the witch's answer to a bad death while the trail is warm.[#]()
